entries.title: Close a started task as done from its record, and see how it was delivered
entries.body: A started task's record now has a Close as done button, also in command search. It asks once, then closes the task on your word: a working crewmate stops, unmerged work is saved, and an open pull request stays open. A task closed as done now has a Delivered row on its record that says how the work was delivered, such as a pull request merged or still open, or edits saved, each marked Checked or As stated.

picture.alt: A done task's record reads Finished on your word, then a Delivered row: its pull request still open and its edits saved, each marked Checked
